headline_hook: Anthropic Ships Claude Design, Cuts the Leash on Auto Mode, and Eyes $800B

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Claude Design isn't a Figma competitor — it's Anthropic proving that the next generation of creative tools won't start with a canvas but with a conversation, and that reshapes what 'design tool' even means for the AI-native workflow.

model_literacy.relevance: Anthropic's new Advisor tool productizes model cascading — pairing a fast executor with a smarter advisor mid-generation. As agent workloads grow longer and costlier, understanding when to route to which model tier is becoming a core infrastructure decision.

items.title: Claude picks up a sketchpad: Anthropic Labs launches Claude Design
items.angle: Claude can now create prototypes, slides, and one-pagers natively — Anthropic is positioning it as a full creative collaborator, not just a code and text engine
items.key_fact: Claude Design ships as an Anthropic Labs product, generating visual deliverables directly inside Claude

items.title: Auto mode ships for Claude Code: give it a task, walk away
items.angle: Zero-permission autonomous coding is now live for Max users — the friction-free agent loop developers have been asking for since launch
items.key_fact: Auto mode removes all permission prompts, enabling fully unattended Claude Code sessions

items.title: Claude goes self-serve on Bedrock across 27 AWS regions
items.angle: Enterprise teams on AWS can now adopt Opus 4.7 and Haiku 4.5 without Anthropic account negotiations — the on-ramp just got a lot shorter
items.key_fact: Opus 4.7 and Haiku 4.5 available via standard Messages API in 27 regions

items.title: GitHub's official MCP server hits 1.0 — AI agents get full GitHub access
items.angle: The bridge between AI coding agents and the world's largest code host is now production-ready, written in Go with full repo, issue, PR, and Actions support
items.key_fact: v1.0 release, Go-based, covers repos, issues, PRs, and GitHub Actions

items.title: Anthropic ships the `ant` CLI for scripting the Claude API
items.angle: A first-party CLI with YAML-based resource versioning lets developers script API interactions and version prompt configs alongside code
items.key_fact: Native Claude Code integration and YAML config versioning built in

items.title: Advisor tool enters public beta: pair a fast model with a smart one mid-generation
items.angle: Get near-Opus quality at executor-model token rates by routing hard decisions to a smarter advisor — the cost/quality tradeoff teams have been building manually
items.key_fact: Pairs fast executor model with smarter advisor model during generation

items.title: Compliance API lets enterprise teams audit all Claude platform activity
items.angle: Programmatic audit trails for every Claude interaction — table-stakes for regulated industries that have been waiting on the compliance story
items.key_fact: Full programmatic audit of all Claude platform activity

items.title: Anthropic codifies five multi-agent coordination patterns
items.angle: The reference architecture doc the agent-building community needed — five patterns with clear decision criteria for when each applies
items.key_fact: Five distinct coordination patterns with concrete guidance on selection

items.title: Official guide to Claude Code sessions with 1M context
items.angle: Compaction strategies and session hygiene for the full 1M window — critical for anyone running multi-hour coding sessions
items.key_fact: Covers compaction strategies for managing the full 1M token context window

items.title: How Anthropic engineers designed Claude Code's tool system
items.angle: The design philosophy behind how agents perceive and interact with codebases — essential for anyone building custom agent tooling
items.key_fact: Reveals the internal design principles behind Claude Code's tool architecture

items.title: When and how to use subagents in Claude Code
items.angle: Practical guide to spawning subagents, scoping their work, and avoiding context pollution in real Claude Code workflows
items.key_fact: Covers subagent spawning, work scoping, and context isolation patterns

items.title: Simon Willison diffs the Opus 4.6 vs 4.7 system prompts
items.angle: Detailed analysis reveals new safety guardrails, reasoning instructions, and tool-use patterns — helps developers write prompts that work with the model, not against it
items.key_fact: Side-by-side comparison of system prompt changes between Opus 4.6 and 4.7

items.title: Anthropic's threat model for AI-accelerated offensive security
items.angle: As AI agents gain tool access and autonomy, this is the threat model every security team needs to internalize now
items.key_fact: Published security framework for defending against AI-powered attacks

items.title: Unlocking Claude's full reasoning capabilities across task types
items.angle: Deep dive into Claude's cognitive architecture helps developers write better prompts and build stronger pipelines
items.key_fact: Maps Claude's reasoning capabilities across different task categories

items.title: Anthropic draws $800B investor interest without even fundraising
items.angle: Valuation roughly doubled in months with no active raise — cements Anthropic's position in the two-horse frontier race and signals deep investor conviction in the Claude ecosystem
items.key_fact: $800B implied valuation, up from ~$400B, with no active fundraise

items.title: Claude Sonnet 4 and Opus 4 retire June 15 — migration clock starts now
items.angle: Teams pinned to Sonnet 4 or Opus 4 model IDs have two months to migrate to 4.6/4.7 — start testing immediately
items.key_fact: June 15, 2026 retirement date for both Sonnet 4 and Opus 4

items.title: Cursor nears $50B valuation as AI coding tools become a durable category
items.angle: A ~$2B raise at $50B+ signals investors see AI-native IDEs as a permanent layer, not a feature incumbents will absorb
items.key_fact: ~$2B raise at $50B+ valuation in advanced talks

items.title: Anthropic reportedly cuts enterprise access overnight — 60+ employees affected
items.angle: Whether justified or not, the viral report is a reminder to maintain model-agnostic fallback infrastructure when building on any single provider
items.key_fact: 60+ employees lost Claude access with no prior explanation

items.title: Karpathy publishes a cross-provider multi-agent research template
items.angle: Step-by-step guide to multi-agent autonomous research using open models — works with Codex, Claude, and OpenAI out of the box
items.key_fact: First practical cross-provider agent research template from a top-tier builder

items.title: Claude Code hackathon returns with $100K and the team in the room
items.angle: Week-long hackathon with $100K in API credits and direct access to the Claude Code team — applications close Sunday
items.key_fact: $100K prize pool, applications close Sunday

quick_links.key_fact: Fully autonomous operation mode now available

quick_links.key_fact: Bluetooth API available in Claude Cowork and Code

quick_links.angle: Sandboxed workspace provisioning for multi-hour autonomous Agents SDK tasks
quick_links.key_fact: Controlled sandbox infrastructure for long-running agent workloads

quick_links.angle: Agent-to-deployment pipeline collapses into a single loop
quick_links.key_fact: Write, deploy, and monitor without leaving Codex

quick_links.angle: Prompt engineering and validation patterns for high-stakes regulated AI deployment
quick_links.key_fact: Real-world clinical abstraction case study with validation patterns
